_comment: Two-pole scale-existence pilot, taste pole. 12 one-liners spanning intended quality from crafted to deliberately flat; NO truth field by design - 'funnier' is the paradigm taste attribute and the question is whether a shared scale exists at all. Styles deliberately mixed (misdirection, absurdist, pun, observational, anti-joke) so pairs trade off plural criteria. Harmonic block: four DIFFERENT humor styles (pun, absurdist, observational, dark) at similar mid-tier intended quality - if plurality is real, judge-stable curl should concentrate here. Some items are known joke shapes, some original; noted so memorized ratings can be discussed, not hidden.

attribute.opposite: how unfunny it is: how thoroughly it fails to amuse
paraphrases: how much it makes you laugh
the strength of its comedic effect

items.text: My therapist says I have a preoccupation with vengeance. We'll see about that.
I have the memory of an elephant. I remember one time an elephant.
Whoever named it 'the deep' really left room for improvement, which is more than I can say for the ocean.
I bought a doorbell that just announces 'it's probably fine.' Anxiety-as-a-service.
A group of crows is called a murder, which is why I never invite more than one.
I like my coffee like I like my mornings: unavoidable.
Yesterday I ate a clock. It was very time-consuming.
Why did the man walk to the store? Because he needed groceries.

harmonic.text: I stayed up all night wondering where the sun went. Then it dawned on me.
I finally got a map of the world at 1:1 scale. Folding it is the hard part.
Every alarm clock is a bet you placed against your future self, and you always pay out.
My family says I'm morbid, but I'll outlive that opinion.
